Chat request with seed parameter for deterministic output; response includes system_fingerprint

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "liter_llm"
result = LiterLlm.chat(LiterLlm::ChatCompletionRequest.new(messages: [{ 'content' => 'Pick a random number', 'role' => 'user' }], model: 'gpt-4', seed: 42))
puts result.choices.inspect
puts result.choices[0].finish_reason.inspect
puts result.system_fingerprint.inspect
```
